d: Who We Are: At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world’s fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

Summary: We are looking for a highly creative, culturally connected, and strategic Assistant Manager, Influencer Marketing to join Huda Beauty. The ideal candidate lives and breathes influencer marketing, has a strong understanding of the global creator landscape, and is always ahead of emerging trends, talent, and cultural conversations. This role requires someone with a deep understanding of social media, a strong global perspective, and the ability to identify talent, build meaningful relationships, and develop impactful influencer strategies that keep Huda Beauty at the forefront of beauty and culture.
q: Strong understanding of the global influencer marketing landscape, ideally within beauty, luxury, fashion, or consumer brands.
Advanced experience with influencer analytics platforms such as Traackr, CreatorIQ, or similar tools.
Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to connect marketing performance to business growth, ROI, and sales.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across departments, markets, and external partners.
Proven experience managing and developing teams.
Demonstrated ability to operate independently and proactively in a fast-paced, founder-led global business.
5+ years of experience in influencer marketing.
r: Develop and execute creative influencer marketing strategies across global campaigns, product launches, and brand moments.
Identify opportunities to position Huda Beauty at the intersection of beauty, entertainment, and pop culture.
Build influencer activations that drive brand desirability, cultural relevance, and social conversation.\
Collaborate with regional markets to ensure global consistency while embracing local cultural nuances.
Bring fresh, innovative ideas that push beyond traditional influencer marketing.
Identify, engage, and build strong relationships with relevant creators, influencers, celebrities, and emerging talent globally.
Maintain a strong understanding of the influencer landscape across key markets, including the US, UK, Europe, Middle East, and Asia.
Spot rising talent and emerging communities before they become mainstream.
Manage influencer partnerships, collaborations, and negotiations from concept through execution.
Build authentic, long-term relationships with talent and their management teams.
Stay constantly connected to global pop culture, social media trends, and emerging digital conversations.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of platforms including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging social channels.
Understand what makes content engaging, shareable, culturally relevant, and potentially viral.
Identify cultural moments, entertainment opportunities, and trending conversations that Huda Beauty can authentically participate in.
Bring a strong point of view on how influencer marketing and social media are evolving, particularly within beauty and Gen Z audiences.
Collaborate closely with creative, social, brand marketing, and product teams to develop compelling influencer-led campaigns.
Translate campaign objectives into creative influencer concepts and engaging social-first storytelling.
Oversee influencer content creation, ensuring strong brand alignment while preserving creator authenticity.
Manage influencer experiences, events, trips, and activations in collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
Challenge conventional approaches and continuously explore new ways to generate excitement around the brand.
Work closely with regional teams to identify market-specific talent and opportunities with global potential.
Manage relationships with influencer agencies, talent managers, and external partners.
Ensure strong coordination across markets on key influencer campaigns and initiatives.
Share cultural insights, emerging talent, and creative opportunities across the wider organization.

d: To build the Internal Audit Department as an independent unit with the right resources and processes / tools, to provide reasonable assurance to key stakeholders (Board Audit, Risk, and Compliance Committee (BARC), CEO, Executive Management / Board of Directors (BOD) / senior management / Shareholders) that Company is managing risk effectively and implementing robust governance and internal control measures in line with International Standards. Additionally, the position entails advising relevant stakeholders on best practices to enhance organizational value.
The role also serves as Secretary to BARC, ensuring effective committee governance, coordination, and communication between the Committee, management, and assurance providers.
This role is guided in accordance with the applicable Laws and Regulations, best international practices, as well as both local & international standards.
q: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Excellent report writing and presentation skills.
High level of integrity, objectivity, and professionalism.
Ability to manage multiple audits and meet deadlines.
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
Professional certification preferred (CIA, ACCA, CPA, CISA, or equivalent).

Minimum of 7+ years of progressive internal audit experience, preferably within asset management, investment banking, financial services, or a top-tier Big 4 audit firm handling financial services portfolios.
r: Establish and develop the Internal Audit function, including frameworks and methodologies.
Develop and maintain the Internal Audit Charter for Audit Committee approval.
Prepare a risk-based internal audit plan aligned with business priorities.
Lead internal audit engagements across operational, financial, compliance, and IT areas.
Assess the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Identify key and emerging risks and recommend practical improvements.
Support and enhance the organization’s governance and control environment.
Monitor compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.
Support regulatory reviews and external audits where required.
Promote best practices in governance and risk management.
Present audit plans, results, and insights to the Audit Committee.
Provide independent views on key risks and control effectiveness.
Escalate significant issues and emerging risks.
Support the Committee in fulfilling its oversight responsibilities.
Serve as Secretary to the Audit Committee, ensuring effective coordination and governance.
Coordinate meeting agendas with the Committee Chair.
Prepare and circulate meeting packs and supporting materials.
Record minutes and track decisions and action items.
Maintain Committee records and annual plans.
Facilitate communication between the Committee, Board, and management.
Ensure alignment with corporate governance requirements.
Deliver clear and timely audit reports.
Monitor implementation of agreed management actions.
Provide regular updates to senior management and the Audit Committee.
Share insights on recurring risks and control themes.
Build and develop the Internal Audit team.
Promote a culture of integrity, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
Ensure adherence to professional standards and ethics.
Encourage innovation and modern audit practices.
Provide advisory support on governance, risk, and controls while maintaining independence.
Stay updated on emerging risks and regulatory developments.
Maintain a Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP).
Internal: Board Audit, Risk and Compliance Committee, BoD, senior Management, Business Line and other members of the Business/Function.
External: Government Authorities, External Legal Counsels, and specialized consultants.

d: We are seeking a Technical Trainer with 5+ years of hands-on professional experience in Systems Engineering, Systems Administration, or IT Infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have practical experience working in corporate IT environments, with a good understanding of server administration, operating systems, networking, and virtualization technologies.

The candidate will be responsible for delivering theoretical and practical training programs, transferring industry knowledge, and preparing trainees with the technical skills required in the job market.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
+5 years of professional experience in Systems Engineering, Systems Administration, or IT Infrastructure.
Previous hands-on experience working in corporate IT environments.
Good practical knowledge of server administration, operating systems, and IT infrastructure.
Familiarity with networking fundamentals and virtualization technologies.
Basic knowledge of cloud platforms and infrastructure solutions.
Strong communication, presentation, and knowledge-sharing skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and deliver practical training sessions.
Previous experience in technical training, mentoring, or delivering workshops.
Professional certifications in Microsoft, VMware, Cisco, or Linux technologies.
Experience in developing training materials, technical labs, and practical exercises.
r: Deliver theoretical and hands-on training in systems administration and IT infrastructure.
Teach Windows Server and Linux administration.
Explain and demonstrate Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, permissions, and identity and access management.
Deliver introductory training on networking concepts relevant to system administration, including TCP/IP, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, common network protocols, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
Provide practical training in virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V.
Introduce cloud infrastructure concepts using Microsoft Azure, AWS, or a comparable cloud platform.
Teach backup, recovery, disaster-recovery, patching, maintenance, and system-monitoring practices.
Introduce infrastructure security principles, including system hardening, least privilege, access control, and secure configuration.
Introduce relevant automation and scripting using PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, or similar tools.
Design and maintain practical labs, exercises, demonstrations, and troubleshooting scenarios.
Develop technical assessments that measure both theoretical understanding and practical ability.
Prepare, review, and update presentations, lab guides, trainee manuals, and other learning resources.
Monitor trainee attendance, participation, technical progress, and assessment results.
Provide constructive feedback, coaching, and additional technical support when required.
Maintain safe, stable, and properly documented training-lab environments.
Review training content regularly to ensure alignment with industry practices and market requirements.
